evidence: Has Wallet label and modifies CWallet::CommitTransaction() in src/wallet/wallet.cpp and src/wallet/wallet.h along with wallet unit tests.
rationale: It fixes a noticeable reliability bug where frontends falsely report success when the node rejects a transaction. The PR description notes that 'The QML GUI shows "Transaction sent" even when the node rejected the transaction, because CWallet::CommitTransaction() only logs the rejection and returns void', and propagating errors resolves this while unblocking gui-qml#1008.
